messages:
Ava: Quick sync — we need to frame the v1->v2 cutover as 'rollforward with opt-in' for customers with non-breaking defaults. Draft proposal below, please react with +1 / concerns.

Sam: Love that. Key Q: how strict is schema compatibility for structured output? We have intentional changes to "items" -> "results" in v2.

Ava: We can't break existing parsers. Proposal: add "results" as top-level in v2 while preserving "items" as alias for 12 months, with deprecation header. Add header `X-Redwood-Compat: items->results` for clients opting into new naming.

Priya: For function/tool-calling: v2 returns richer tool metadata. Suggest compatibility shim in SDK that maps old fields -> new ones automatically for v1 routes.

Jordan: Customers with strict regex-based parsers (finance) will need a migration window. Recommend 18 months with staged warnings at 3/9/15 months.

Sam: Ok, rollout plan sketches:
```
Phase 0: opt-in flag (v2-route=early) + no default
Phase 1: default v2 for new orgs, v1 still available
Phase 2: v1 deprecated -> docs warnings
Phase 3: v1 removed after 18 months unless enterprise extension
```

Ava: Launch criteria (must pass all):
- SDK shims in js/py/rust
- E2E regression below 0.5% for top 100 prompts
- Telemetry: parse_fail rate, schema_mismatch rate, latency delta
- Docs + migration guide published

Priya: Eval details: regression tests include tool calling, streaming, embeddings shape, rerank score deltas. We'll need a "compat harness" repo.

Sam: Ops: router fallback policy: if v2 fails, auto-route to v1 for same request id up to 3 retries. Need tracing tags to verify.

Ava: Ask Legal: deprecation notice wording + SLA exceptions for Dedicated/Private. Jordan will own comms to customers.

Jordan: I can draft the customer playbook: migration checklist, sample code, regex snippets, rollback steps.

Priya: Implementation blockers: some kernels optimized for v2 structured output. Need to ensure KV cache and batching unaffected.

Sam: Risks: hidden behavioral diffs in generation leading to subtle downstream logic break. Mitigation: shadow rollouts, canary with 5% of orgs, automated quality gates.

Ava: Action items:
- Priya: define compat harness tests + timeline (due 2w)
- Sam: SDK shim PRs + router fallback logic (due 3w)
- Jordan: draft customer playbook + comms (due 1w)
- Legal: deprecation wording (sync Tues)
- Product: finalize deprecation timeline and ship criteria

Sam: One more: embeddings format — v2 includes `pooling_strategy` field. We'll make it optional and default to legacy value when missing.

Jordan: For enterprise customers we should offer extended deprecation window and migration support packages.

Ava: Great. If no objections by EOD I'll convert this thread into an RFC and schedule a 30m sync Thurs. :thumbsup:
